name: Dual Stage Boost Controller V2 - Black
title: Dual Stage Boost Controller V2 - Black
description:
The Dual Stage Boost Controller V2 - Black utilizes Turbosmart's proven gated boost control system to bring boost on faster and prevent premature wastegate opening.

Technical Specifications:
• Brand & Engineering: Genuine Turbosmart high-performance motorsport hardware.
• Construction: Precision CNC-machined billet aluminum housing with hard-anodized finish.
• Control Type: Detent adjustment system for precise, leak-free boost adjustments.
• Flow Efficiency: Gated feature minimizes wastegate creep and improves turbo spool response.
